description: Executions whose expiry time is exactly equal to either the start or the end bound of the window are excluded, so only expiry times strictly between the two bounds count.

d.request: Treat the window as exclusive on both ends, so only executions with an `orderexecutions.expirespot` text value strictly greater than '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and strictly less than '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' count. Join each of these to `orders` on `recordvault` = `ordersmark` (inner join, dropping unmatched executions) and group by `ordersmark` and `orderflow`. Compute each group's average `fillcount`, ignoring nulls. Then return the unrounded average of those per-group averages, ignoring null group averages.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS group_avg FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark WHERE oe.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) t WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL

a.request: Match each order execution to its order (where the order's `recordvault` equals the execution's `ordersmark`, and executions without a matching order are dropped). Keep only executions whose expiry time (`expirespot`) falls between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533', with both endpoints excluded (comparing the values as text). Group them by order reference (`ordersmark`) and order status (`orderflow`), and compute each group's average filled quantity (`fillcount`, ignoring missing values). Then give me a single value: the average of those per-group averages (ignoring missing ones), without rounding.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS result FROM (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) t

c.request: For order executions that have a matching order (where the order's `recordvault` equals the execution's `ordersmark`; drop executions with no match) and an expiry time (`expirespot`) between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' (comparing the values as text), group them by order reference (`ordersmark`) and order status (`orderflow`), and work out each group's average filled quantity (`fillcount`, ignoring missing values). What is the average of those per-group averages (ignoring missing ones), without rounding? Executions whose expiry time is exactly equal to either the start or the end bound of the window are excluded, so only expiry times strictly between the two bounds count.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS group_avg FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) t WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL
